summary: Hot Chips 2026 (Aug 23-25) dominated the week: Nvidia detailed Rubin/Vera, AMD detailed MI400/MI455X and the Helios rack, and OpenAI publicly unveiled Jalapeno, its first Broadcom-built custom inference ASIC. Two long-standing hardware gap sub-themes finally got real items from the same venue - photonic/optical compute (Opticore's homodyne tensor crossbar) and consumer/edge NPUs (UC Berkeley's Gemmelos). In bio, FDA approved Mounjaro for cardiovascular risk reduction, Moderna/Merck posted the first-ever positive Phase 3 for an individualized mRNA cancer vaccine, and Charite published a six-patient CAR-T reversal of refractory rheumatoid arthritis in Nature Medicine. The week's dominant thesis across voices was that the AI build-out's binding constraint has moved from chip supply to power, skilled labor, and capital. Verification: 29 passed, 5 fixed (a fabricated 16% all-cause-mortality figure on Mounjaro, a wrong Starship Flight 14 date, a stale Dwarkesh URL, a backfill flag), 0 dropped. Entity reconciliation added 7 players we were tracking the news about but not the player behind it - Opticore, Charite Berlin, BindCraft/EPFL, Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center, Inherent, Inertia Enterprises, and Quantum Circuits Inc (the Yale spinout whose dual-rail qubit D-Wave's Nature result actually rests on).

highlights.title: Nvidia discloses Rubin GPU + Vera CPU architecture at Hot Chips 2026
highlights.detail: Nvidia publicly detailed the Rubin GPU and Vera CPU for the first time, claiming Vera Rubin NVL72 delivers 10x-30x more tokens per megawatt than GB300 NVL72 on SemiAnalysis' AgentX benchmark at high interactivity.

highlights.title: AMD details MI455X (432GB HBM4) and 2.9-exaflop Helios rack at Hot Chips
highlights.detail: AMD disclosed MI455X with 432GB of HBM4 at 23.3TB/s and 40.26 PFLOPS MXFP4; the 72-GPU Helios rack delivers 2.9 exaflops, 31TB HBM4 and 1.7PB/s of bandwidth, shipping Q3 2026.

highlights.title: OpenAI unveils Jalapeno, its first custom inference ASIC, with Broadcom
highlights.detail: OpenAI presented Jalapeno at Hot Chips 2026 - a Broadcom-built inference ASIC designed in nine months with AI-assisted design, scaling to a 2,048-chip domain over Tomahawk6 switches, claiming ~50% better cost-efficiency than merchant GPUs with volume production in 2027.

highlights.title: FDA approves Mounjaro for cardiovascular risk reduction in type 2 diabetes
highlights.detail: FDA approved tirzepatide on Aug 28, 2026 to reduce major adverse cardiovascular events in adults with T2D at high CV risk, based on SURPASS-CVOT (13,299 patients) showing an 8% lower rate of CV death, heart attack or stroke vs. dulaglutide (HR 0.92) - the first GIP/GLP-1 dual agonist with a CV label.

highlights.title: First positive Phase 3 for an individualized mRNA cancer vaccine (melanoma)
highlights.detail: Moderna/Merck's intismeran autogene (mRNA-4157/V940) plus pembrolizumab met both recurrence-free and distant metastasis-free survival endpoints in Phase 3 INTerpath-001 in resected stage IIB-IV melanoma - the first positive Phase 3 for a personalized neoantigen mRNA therapy.

payload.new_value: Phase 3 INTerpath-001 met RFS and DMFS endpoints (Aug 19, 2026)

highlights.detail: Charite Berlin's phase 1 COMPARE trial treated 6 RA patients refractory to up to 8 prior therapies; all six showed markedly reduced disease activity and three were in sustained drug-free remission at up to one year.

highlights.detail: A Cas9-nickase editor fusing engineered adenine/cytosine deaminases with alkyladenine DNA glycosylases achieved simultaneous triple-base editing at 5.7-41% efficiency at endogenous human sites, with up to 3.2x more allelic diversity than dual A-C editors.

highlights.detail: FDA approved an expansion on Aug 26, 2026 letting Paradromics' investigational Connexus BCI connect via its Convey interface to compatible personal laptops, tablets and phones in the Connect-One study without per-device sign-off.

highlights.detail: The Nevada Transportation Authority unanimously approved permits on Aug 20, 2026 allowing Tesla (5,000-vehicle cap), Waymo (1,000) and Uber (1,000) to run commercial robotaxis in Las Vegas over 12 months; Tesla testified it expects only ~2,500 deployed by next year.

highlights.detail: Helmholtz-Zentrum Berlin added an ultra-thin cesium-chloride seed layer between perovskite and silicon sub-cells in a solvent-free co-evaporation process, reaching 30.3% efficiency with fewer defects and larger perovskite grains; published in Joule Aug 26, 2026.

highlights.title: D-Wave demonstrates dual-rail erasure-qubit entangling gate in Nature
highlights.detail: A Swap-Wait-Swap CZ gate between dual-rail cavity qubits reached ~99.9% two-qubit fidelity at ~500ns with ~0.5% erasure rate and post-selected residual Pauli errors below 0.1% - a hardware step toward efficient error-corrected gate-model quantum computing.
